reader.requirement: For a GENERATE or TERMINATE in a contained program, the first qualifying USE BEFORE REPORTING declarative is selected from: the program containing the statement (GLOBAL or not), then a GLOBAL one of the directly containing program, then outward; none if none qualifies.
reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion' in CodeGen/Verbs/ReportWriterEmitter.cs: hits at 596 (engine Edition field), 677 (CONTROL operand) and 902 (SumAdditionsInDependencyOrder), none in ChainSelects, EmitBeforeReportingSelectors or EmitSelectors; Runtime/IO/ReportWriter.cs#RunBeforeReporting takes no edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb369 covers one contained level; the probe adds a three-level chain where a middle program's GLOBAL declarative must win over the outer's and a non-GLOBAL one must be skipped

probes.printed: O-GLOBAL DET N=1 / O-GLOBAL DET2 N=1 / O-LOCAL DET3 N=1 / M-GLOBAL DET N=2 / M-LOCAL DET2 N=2 / M-GLOBAL DET N=3 / O-GLOBAL DET2 N=3 / I DONE / J-OWN DET N=4 / O-GLOBAL DET2 N=4 / O DONE
probes.expected: a: own declarative (USEM's non-GLOBAL DET2, USEJ's DET); b: directly containing program's GLOBAL one (USEM's for USEI's DET); c: skip a non-GLOBAL one and go outward (USEO's for USEI's DET2); none for USEI's DET3 (the outer's is not GLOBAL)

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.5.6.4 GR1  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:X.5.6.4 GR1" "only the first qualifying declarative will be selected for execution")

reader.notes: use3 prints exactly the a/b/c order: USEJ's own, USEM's GLOBAL over USEO's for USEI, USEM's non-GLOBAL DET2 skipped in favour of USEO's GLOBAL one, and nothing for USEI's DET3 whose only declarative (USEO's) is not GLOBAL.

refuter.evidence: The reader's use3 exercised only detail groups GENERATEd by name. use4.cob drives every other group type from a contained program: outer U4O has RD R1 GLOBAL CONTROLS ARE FINAL WS-K with PH, CH WS-K, DE, CF WS-K, CF FINAL and RF groups and USE GLOBAL BEFORE REPORTING for PHG, CHK, CFK, CFG and RFG; contained U4I has its own non-GLOBAL USE BEFORE REPORTING CFK and RFG and runs GENERATE DET (WS-K 1), GENERATE DET (WS-K 2, a control break) and TERMINATE R1. --std 85 EXIT 0: 'O-GLOBAL PHG / O-GLOBAL CHK K=1 / I-OWN CFK K=1 / O-GLOBAL CHK K=2 / I-OWN CFK K=2 / O-GLOBAL CFG / I-OWN RFG / I DONE / O DONE', report 'PH CH 1 CF CH 2 CF CG RF'. The groups the contained program's GENERATE and TERMINATE present implicitly (page heading, control heading, control footing on a break and at TERMINATE, final footing, report footing) each select the contained program's own declarative first (rule 1a: CFK, RFG) and otherwise the container's GLOBAL one (rule 1b: PHG, CHK, CFG), once each. No probe overturned. Citation: OK §1985:X.5.6.4 GR1 ('The declarative within the program that contains the statement which caused the qualifying condition').
